g.text: TRUST BOUNDARY TYPES: each type sets a storage and access rule.
TOPOLOGY: each declared trust boundary has its own brain. C-G6.12 sets the storage isolation rule.

Stateless models use a stable embed-and-recall contract. Each corpus stays in its
own store. The substrate serves each brain through its declared access path.
The erasure authority finds every store that holds material about the subject. Each
holder executes the deletion and records the result. Recovery applies the tombstone
Create a brain with separate storage. Declare each allowed projection in the visibility
map. Connect it to the shared substrate through the stable contract.
Legend. Each heavy border marks one brain and trust boundary. Dashed green boxes are business unit scopes. Dark cylinders are knowledge stores.
The red cylinder is a sensitive-domain store. Blue-grey marks the operational plane. A red rule marks a control point. Edges show allowed data paths.
